name: spirula-studio
description_en: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA.
readme_excerpt: Spirula Studio     Download • Build from Source • Gallery • Web Viewer Spirula Studio trains 3D Gaussian Splatting models – from raw photo/video to splat to textured mesh – in one self-contained binary. No Python/PyTorch, no separate COLMAP install. Runs on NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple GPUs via Vulkan, trains 10M full-SH Gaussians in 8 GB VRAM, and has native support for fisheye and 360° cameras.
